subject: Next steps for Sunridge onboarding: EIN clarification and PO start
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: William Chen <william@srlabs.com>, Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@procureplus.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Sunridge onboarding: EIN + PO timing

William / Amy —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. We’re ready to move Sunridge into procurement; two quick items from our side to avoid delays on the PO:

1) Tax ID: we received the W-9 you uploaded but the EIN in the W-9 PDF (12-3456789) doesn't match the EIN you entered in the vendor portal (12-3456798). Can you confirm the correct EIN and resend a signed W-9 if the PDF needs correction?

2) Notary / remote notarization: does Sunridge have an in-house notary for the signer on the W-9, or would you prefer the remote-notary path (we can accept a remote notarization certificate + notarized PDF)? We’ve included our notary guidance PDF for reference.

If those two are resolved, procurement will issue a preliminary PO within 48 hours for review — Marcus will lead the PO terms. Naomi — can you confirm any additional tax vetting steps for an org of this size (sub $1M anticipated ARR in year one)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround,

—Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Notary_Instructions.pdf (summary guidance on acceptable remote-notary certificates)

From: William Chen <william@srlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@procureplus.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunridge onboarding: EIN + PO timing

Jordan — thanks, and great meeting. Quick clarifications below: 

• EIN: Good catch. The W-9 we uploaded shows 12-3456789 (that is correct). The portal entry was a typo — Amy will correct the portal. I attach the corrected signed W-9 (scanned).

• Notary: We have a company officer who signs and can do a remote notarization through NotaryNow. Is a NotaryNow certificate acceptable? If so, we’ll include the certificate with the signed W-9.

• PO terms: Do you anticipate a standard net-30 payment term? Also flagged: vendor tax withholding — do you require any additional withholding forms for vendors under $50k?

I attached the signed W-9 to this reply. Let me know if you need the original wet-sign scanned or a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Will
VP Finance, Sunridge Labs
Attachments: Sunridge_W9_signed.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:48:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sunridge onboarding: EIN + PO timing

Naomi / Marcus — forwarding Will's reply. He confirmed the W-9 EIN (12-3456789) and said the portal entry was a typo; attached signed PDF. Questions for procurement/tax: 

- Naomi: for an SME like Sunridge (annual spend forecast under $100k), do we need any extra withholding steps or can we proceed after the W-9 verification?
- Marcus: please prepare a preliminary PO (net-30) and include the standard SLA addendum + data processing clause. If the PO needs to reference the W-9 file id, use record DEAL-22714 and note "W9 on file 2027-08-04".

I also asked whether remote-notary via NotaryNow is acceptable — Will will confirm. If we need a wet-sign, flag immediately so we can pause.

—Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: William Chen <william@srlabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunridge onboarding: EIN + PO timing — next steps and DocuSign

Will —

Thanks for the quick update and the signed W-9 — confirmed EIN 12-3456789 matches the PDF. NotaryNow is acceptable; please include the notarization certificate as a separate PDF when you return the final envelope.

Next steps from Redwood: 
1) Procurement will issue a preliminary PO (PO-22714-RED) as a DocuSign envelope for signature. Marcus has included standard net-30 payment terms and our standard SLA/data processing addendum. Expect the DocuSign link within 24 hours.
2) Please confirm whether you prefer the PO signed by the same officer who signed the W-9. If yes, attach the NotaryNow certificate alongside the final DocuSign sign.
3) Naomi: once Marcus uploads PO and supporting docs, can procurement run EIN crosscheck with our third-party vendor validation (TINMatch) and mark the vendor as "Verified" in the vendor registry? If any mismatch, pause PO issuance.

Will — we'll send the DocuSign link shortly. If you need a wet-sign instead, tell us today so we can switch suppliers.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_Terms_Sunridge_22714.docx (draft), Notary_Instructions.pdf
